title: Build versioned, deterministic shopping plans (backlog P1.8)
body:
## Role
A backend engineer turning the current shopping-list preview into a stored, versioned plan.

## Goal
Build deterministic, versioned shopping plans from approved needs and meal demand (backlog P1.8) so approvals and adapters have a stable thing to bind to.

## Context
Today `/api/v1/shopping-list/preview` returns a transient list. #137 needs a plan version to bind, and every adapter needs the same input. #141 is a known consolidation defect.

## Deliverables
`shopping_plans` and `shopping_plan_lines` tables; a builder producing a new version whenever inputs change; each line keeps its canonical item, quantity, unit, reasons and constraints.

## Concrete examples
The same inventory, needs and meals produce the same plan content; marking milk `out` produces version N+1.

## Constraints
Deterministic before any optional model enrichment; retailer-neutral; versions are immutable once stored.

## Dependencies
#133; #135 for needs (the builder can start from today's restock queue and adopt needs when they land).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Same input, same plan.
- [ ] Any input change yields a new version; old versions stay readable.
- [ ] Every line lists all its reasons.

## Testing requirements
Property test for determinism; migration tested on SQLite and Postgres.

## Out of scope
Adapters, approvals, UI beyond the existing list view.

## Documentation requirements
Data Model section of the README; API contract for reading a plan.

## Done-Done (repository requirements)
- Invoke tools through `./scripts/*`, never directly; `./scripts/check-all.sh` exits 0.
- Keep the repository's coverage, typing, lint, security and complexity thresholds; don't weaken any gate.
- No `noqa`, `type: ignore`, disabled checks, test skips or retries added to get green. A flaky test is worse than no test.
- Deterministic contract tests and negative-path tests. Tests use a fake transport; a normal test run never calls Instacart.
- Update the docs and API contracts this change touches in the same PR.
- Review the final diff for Safeway or Instacart coupling in core domain modules (`consolidator`, `pantry_manager`, `recipe_store`, `models`, `pending_actions`).
- The PR body references the epic (#142) and closes this issue.
